Shape the future of healthcare payments

Bluespine has established a new standard for payment integrity and accuracy across the US healthcare system. Join us in empowering self-insured employers to eliminate financial leakage through the reduction of fraud, waste, and abuse in medical claims.

Open Positions

Eliminating FWA in healthcare,
one claim at a time.

Bluespine is an AI-powered platform that helps stakeholders across the U.S. healthcare system reduce fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) while driving down medical costs and mitigating financial and legal risk. As the first fully automated, evidence-based claims auditing solution, Bluespine ensures unmatched payment accuracy by analyzing plan documents, contracts, and price transparency data. Seamlessly integrating into payment integrity workflows, it prevents both provider billing errors and payer adjudication mistakes—saving companies money and protecting their fiduciary interests.
